result: Reviewed the official Python 3.10 sqlite3 and current SQLite transaction/foreign-key documentation, froze expectations before probing, and completed a file-backed SQLite probe on Python 3.12.14 / SQLite 3.53.1. The explicit isolation_level=None + PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON/read-back before BEGIN IMMEDIATE, followed by one COMMIT or rollback of the active transaction, preserved the baseline after a later row conflict and rejected an orphan location. An identical batch ID/digest retry added no duplicate asset or history. A Python 3.10 runtime was unavailable, so that compatibility conclusion is documentation-backed; concurrency/provider behavior remains untested.
